statement: CISA adds a Gitea remote-code-execution vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA KEV catalog JSON on 2026-10-30. Yes if any entry has vendorProject or product matching Gitea and dateAdded between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.

statement: CISA adds a vBulletin vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA KEV catalog JSON on 2026-10-30. Yes if any entry has vendorProject or product matching vBulletin and dateAdded inside the window.

statement: CISA publishes an advisory, alert or advisory update that explicitly names the Minnesota water utility intrusions, on or before 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA cybersecurity advisories index on 2026-09-30. Yes if any item published after 2026-07-29 names Minnesota water utilities or that campaign.

statement: The official confirmed death toll from the 2026-07-28 Kyushu earthquake exceeds 100 as reported on 2026-08-31.
resolution: Resolved from Japan Fire and Disaster Management Agency or Cabinet Office figures published on or before 2026-08-31. Yes if confirmed dead exceed 100.

statement: USGS records at least one earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or greater within 100 km of the 2026-07-28 Uto epicentre between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the USGS FDSN event query, radius 100 km on the Uto epicentre, minmagnitude 5.5, starttime 2026-07-30, endtime 2026-09-30. Yes if any event returns.

statement: GDACS issues a Red alert for any event located in Japan between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the GDACS alert feed on 2026-10-30. Yes if any event with country Japan carries alertlevel Red and a date inside the window.

statement: The United States 10-year Treasury par yield closes at or above 4.90 percent on at least one business day between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the Treasury daily par yield curve XML, field BC_10YEAR, on 2026-10-30. Yes if any business day in the window closed at or above 4.90.

statement: The ECB main refinancing operations rate on 2026-10-30 is unchanged from its level on 2026-07-29.
resolution: Resolved from the ECB Data Portal series FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV on 2026-10-30. Yes if OBS_VALUE on that date equals the 2026-07-29 value.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude settles at or above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the official ICE Brent front-month settlement series read on 2026-09-30. Yes if any settlement in the window is at or above 100.00.

statement: A United States sanctions action designating Iranian persons or entities is published in the Federal Register between 2026-07-30 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the Federal Register documents API on 2026-10-30, agency Treasury or State. Yes if any document published in the window designates Iranian persons or entities.
